description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'ProductDetailFragment' which is an Android Fragment that displays detailed information about a product and allows the user to add it to a shopping cart. It includes UI initialization, data binding, and a factory method for creating instances with specific product IDs.

classes.name: ProductDetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays product details and handles user interactions such as adding the product to a shopping cart.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and retrieves the product based on provided arguments.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, binds UI elements, and sets up the display of product information and button click handler.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ProductDetailFragment with a specific product ID.
